notes.title: Achievements update
notes.notes:
All achievements are updated/fixed for client/server side.

Added new 10 achievements.

notes.title: Update 1.2.1
notes.notes:
Update 1.2.1

Has been added:
- on player character is now lantern which is activated in night
- added weapon Chaingun
- added weapon TNTLauncher
- changed model of sniper weapons
- changed all doors, they stay open after the first opening
- with with the door change zombies can now enter buildings
- little bit changed sky

notes.title: NPC Update
notes.notes: I added another NPC system to the game. NPCs are in different places and are still respawning. They do not do much damage and do not give many points but they will still attack the player if they see him :)
